system.description: The vitae flowing through your veins tastes truly awful. After biting or feeding from you, the victim must make a Simple Test to avoid becoming nauseated for a full scene; no spending Willpower to avoid the test, it simply tastes that bad. If nauseated, the victim suffers a one-Trait penalty on all Physical Challenges. This makes blood bonds torturous, the Embrace even more difficult, and ghouling from you near-impossible.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter One ("Legends and History"), "Merits and Flaws"
